StellCoilBench Leaderboard

The StellCoilBench leaderboard provides a comprehensive comparison of coil optimization methods across different plasma surfaces. Each submission is evaluated using standardized metrics that measure both the quality of the magnetic field produced and the engineering feasibility of the coil designs.

Note

This page is automatically regenerated by CI after each successful submission. For local development, run stellcoilbench update-db to refresh the leaderboard.
